title: Classic Espresso
description: A bold and concentrated coffee shot brewed from finely ground beans. Its rich aroma and intense flavor make it the perfect choice for true coffee lovers seeking a quick burst of energy with every sip.

title: Americano
description: A smooth and balanced coffee created by blending espresso with hot water. It offers a lighter body while retaining the richness of espresso, making it perfect for those who enjoy a longer, mellow coffee experience.

title: Cappuccino
description: A timeless Italian favorite crafted with equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and milk foam. The velvety texture, frothy top, and balanced taste make it a popular morning beverage for coffee enthusiasts worldwide.

title: Cafe Latte
description: A comforting blend of espresso and steamed milk topped with a thin layer of foam. Its smooth texture and mild flavor make it a versatile choice, enjoyed plain or with flavored syrups.

title: Mocha Delight
description: A chocolate lover’s dream – a decadent mix of espresso, steamed milk, and rich chocolate syrup. Finished with whipped cream and cocoa powder, this drink delivers indulgence in every sip.

title: Iced Americano
description: A refreshing twist on the classic Americano, served over ice. Smooth and crisp with a lingering espresso flavor, it’s the ideal pick-me-up for hot days without losing the authentic coffee kick.

title: Caramel Cold Brew
description: A slow-steeped cold brew coffee infused with caramel syrup, creating a sweet yet bold drink. Served chilled, it provides a smooth caffeine kick with notes of sweetness that linger on the palate.

title: Hazelnut Iced Latte
description: A nutty variation of the iced latte, crafted with espresso, cold milk, and hazelnut syrup. This drink is creamy, lightly sweet, and perfect for those who enjoy coffee with a nut-flavored twist.

title: Velvet Roast Frappe
description: A luxurious blended iced coffee topped with whipped cream. With its silky texture and balanced sweetness, this frappe is both refreshing and indulgent, ideal as a treat or dessert drink.

title: Morning Bliss Brew
description: A signature house blend designed to kickstart your day with balanced flavors and a smooth finish. This coffee combines beans from different origins, offering a bright and energizing cup every morning.
